## 简体中文

### 修复

- WinTaskbar 未激活时仍保持任务栏和托盘悬停工具提示可见，包括电池与镜像状态项标题。
- 在 Fluent 材质层上方渲染单行和多行时钟工具提示，统一文字、内边距、边框和外观。
- 在任务栏外缘以标准 8pt 间距定位工具提示，适配任务栏四个方向并防止时钟工具提示与任务栏重叠。
- 开始按钮、任务栏应用、溢出控件、系统托盘项和时钟统一使用相同的工具提示表面与定位，同时保留各自的辅助功能标签。

## English

### Fixed

- Kept taskbar and tray hover tooltips visible while WinTaskbar is inactive, including battery and mirrored status-item titles.
- Rendered single-line and multiline clock tooltips above the Fluent material layer with consistent text, padding, border, and appearance.
- Anchored tooltips to the taskbar's outer edge with the standard 8pt gap on every taskbar side, preventing the clock tooltip from overlapping the taskbar.
- Used the same tooltip surface and placement for Start, taskbar apps, overflow controls, system tray items, and the clock while preserving their accessibility labels.
